import sys, json, subprocess, os, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
from agent_comms.field_codec import FieldCodec
from agent_comms.comms import Comms
from agent_comms.owner_launch import RetainedOwnerLaunch
from agent_comms.owner_restart import OwnerRestartRequest
from agent_comms.active_route import read_active_route
from publish_retained_summary import ROOT, ReviewedArtifact, ReviewedRetainedSummaryCohort, InstalledSourceProof, CohortActivation
from native_schema_carry import NativeSchemaDeclaration
from checkpoint_schema import declared_schema_digest
from runtime_installation import PreserveRuntimeInstallation
base = Path(sys.argv[2])
inputs = json.loads((base / 'qualification-input.json').read_text())
assert not (base / 'publication-receipt.json').exists() and (not (base / 'publication-receipt.originals').exists())
proof_path = base / 'source-proof.json'
activation_path = base / 'candidate-activation.json'
proof = FieldCodec.decode(InstalledSourceProof, json.loads(proof_path.read_text()))
activation = FieldCodec.decode(CohortActivation, json.loads(activation_path.read_text()))
proof.require_activation(activation)
assert sys.executable == str(proof.prefix / 'bin/python')
service = Comms(ROOT, private_initial_writes=False, private_claim_writes=False)
snapshot = service.registry.snapshot()
launches = tuple((RetainedOwnerLaunch.capture(t, snapshot) for t in OwnerRestartRequest().threads(snapshot)))
assert len(launches) == 19
interpreters = {x.interpreter for x in launches}
assert len(interpreters) == 1
source_python = Path(next(iter(interpreters)))
assert source_python == Path(inputs['current_prefix']) / 'bin/python'
child = "import sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);from agent_comms.field_codec import FieldCodec;from native_schema_carry import NativeSchemaDeclaration;from checkpoint_schema import declared_schema_digest;print(json.dumps({'native':FieldCodec.encode(NativeSchemaDeclaration.observe()),'checkpoint':declared_schema_digest()}))"
env = dict(os.environ)
env.pop('PYTHONPATH', None)
env.pop('PYTHONHOME', None)
packet = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(source_python), '-I', '-B', '-c', child, sys.argv[1]], env=env, text=True))
original = FieldCodec.decode(NativeSchemaDeclaration, packet['native'])
target = NativeSchemaDeclaration.observe()
original.require_carry_target(target)
assert original == target and packet['checkpoint'] == declared_schema_digest(), 'Actual declaration/checkpoint differs: return source/target to original NativeSchemaCarryPlan owner; no inferred reset/carry'
artifact = lambda p: ReviewedArtifact(p, hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
gates = tuple((FieldCodec.decode(ReviewedArtifact, r) for r in inputs['actual_gates']))
cohort = ReviewedRetainedSummaryCohort(proof.prefix, Path(inputs['current_prefix']), read_active_route(), proof.native_package, artifact(activation_path), artifact(proof_path), gates)
cohort.require_original()
runtime = PreserveRuntimeInstallation(original.goal)
values = [('original-declaration.json', FieldCodec.encode(original)), ('target-declaration.json', FieldCodec.encode(target)), ('checkpoint-relation.json', {'source': packet['checkpoint'], 'target': declared_schema_digest(), 'source_python_owner': 'RetainedOwnerLaunch'}), ('review-plan.json', FieldCodec.encode(cohort)), ('runtime-installation.json', FieldCodec.encode(runtime))]
for name, value in values:
    with (base / name).open('x') as f:
        json.dump(value, f, indent=2)
        f.write('\n')
print('Original typed whole cohort and PreserveRuntimeInstallation prepared; public writes0')
